failures.test: RESOLVED. parseHandle now routes facet through validateAndReconstructFacet() (rejects any key != `fields`, non-array fields, non-string elements). Re-verified live (rt-choros 2026-06-10): the R-2 repro `facet:{fields:['a'],data:{ssn}}` now throws MalformedHandleError; honest `{fields:[...]}` facet still round-trips. Covered by FF-9-R2 block in src/__tests__/object-handle.test.ts.

RESOLVED. parseHandle now feeds validated (ref,tenantId,facet) into makeHandle, inheriting the cross-tenant check. Re-verified live (rt-choros 2026-06-10): the R-3 repro (wire ref.tenantId != envelope tenantId) now throws CrossTenantHandleError at parity with makeHandle, for all three ref kinds. Covered by FF-9-R3 block.

RESOLVED. makeHandle now attaches the runtime brand `_RUNTIME_BRAND` via Object.defineProperty({value:true,enumerable:false,writable:false,configurable:false}) on an Object.create(null) base with only named identity props enumerable, then Object.freeze. Object spread / Object.assign / JSON clone therefore cannot copy the brand. New FF-A2 test block (src/__tests__/object-handle.test.ts:888-955) asserts: object-spread clone fails isObjectHandle; Object.assign({},h) fails isObjectHandle; spread-clone + appended .data is rejected by assertVariableValue; genuine handles still pass isObjectHandle (all 3 ref kinds, with/without facet); serialize→parse round-trips intact (all 3 kinds ±facet). Re-verified live (rt-choros-T0015-final 2026-06-10): the R-4 repro {...h} now yields isObjectHandle===false; JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(h)) also false; spread+data => assertVariableValue {ok:false}; no regression to honest round-trip. The everyday-idiom opacity-bypass class is closed; only deliberate in-process symbol-introspection forgery remains, which is out of the operative threat model (enforcement.md §7).
